verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm for the sons of Core.

translations.ron: Bine ai voit, Doamne, pământului Tău, întors-ai robimea lui Iacob.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορὲ ψαλμός.

verses.translation: O Lord, thou hast taken pleasure in thy land: thou hast turned back the captivity of Jacob.

translations.ron: Iertat-ai fărădelegile poporului Tău, acoperit-ai toate păcatele lor.
translations.grk: Εὐδόκησας Κύριε τὴν γῆν σου, ἀπέστρεψας τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ἰακώβ.

verses.translation: Thou hast forgiven thy people their transgressions; thou hast covered all their sins. Pause.

translations.ron: Potolit-ai toată mânia Ta; întorsu-Te-ai de către iuţimea mâniei Tale.
translations.grk: Ἀφῆκας τὰς ἀνομίας τῷ λαῷ σου, ἐκάλυψας πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Thou hast caused all thy wrath to cease: thou hast turned from thy fierce anger.

translations.ron: Întoarce-ne pe noi, Dumnezeul mântuirii noastre şi-ţi întoarce mânia Ta de la noi.
translations.grk: Κατέπαυσας πᾶσαν τὴν ὀργήν σου, ἀπέστρεψας ἀπὸ ὀργῆς θυμοῦ σου.

verses.translation: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and turn thine anger away from us.

translations.ron: Oare, în veci Te vei mânia pe noi? Sau vei întinde mânia Ta din neam în neam?
translations.grk: Ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς τῶν σωτηρίων ἡμῶν, καὶ ἀπόστρεψον τὸν θυμόν σου ἀφʼ ἡμῶν.

verses.translation: Wouldest thou be angry with us for ever? or wilt thou continue thy wrath from generation to generation?

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, Tu întorcându-Te, ne vei dărui viaţă şi poporul Tău se va veseli de Tine.
translations.grk: Μὴ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὀργισθῇς ἡμῖν; ἢ διατενεῖς τὴν ὀργήν σου ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεάν;

verses.translation: O God, thou wilt turn and quicken us; and thy people shall rejoice in thee.

translations.ron: Arată-ne nouă, Doamne, mila Ta şi mântuirea Ta dă-ne-o nouă.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς, σὺ ἐπιστρέψας ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς, καὶ ὁ λαός σου εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ σοί.

verses.translation: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

translations.ron: Auzi-voi ce va grăi întru mine Domnul Dumnezeu; că va grăi pace peste poporul Său
translations.grk: Δεῖξον ἡμῖν Κύριε τὸ ἔλεός σου, καὶ τὸ σωτήριόν σου δῴης ἡμῖν.

verses.translation: I will hear what the Lord God will say concerning me: for he shall speak peace to his people, and to his saints, and to those that turn their heart toward him.

translations.ron: Şi peste cuvioşii Săi şi peste cei ce îşi întorc inima spre Dânsul.
translations.grk: Ἀκούσομαι τί λαλήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς, ὅτι λαλήσει εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐπιστρέφοντας πρὸς αὐτὸν καρδίαν.

verses.translation: Moreover his salvation is near them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

translations.ron: Dar mântuirea Lui aproape este de cei ce se tem de Dânsul, ca să se sălăşluiască slava în pământul nostru.
translations.grk: Πλὴν ἐγγὺς τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ, τοῦ κατασκηνῶσαι δόξαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἡμῶν.

verses.translation: Mercy and truth are met together: righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

translations.ron: Mila şi adevărul s-au întâmpinat, dreptatea şi pacea s-au sărutat.
translations.grk: Ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια συνήντησαν, δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη κατεφίλησαν.

verses.translation: Truth has sprung out of the earth; and righteousness has looked down from heaven.

translations.ron: Adevărul din pământ a răsărit şi dreptatea din cer a privit.
translations.grk: Ἀλήθεια ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἀνέτειλε, καὶ δικαιοσύνη ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψε.

verses.translation: For the Lord will give goodness; and our land shall yield her fruit.

translations.ron: Că Domnul va da bunătate şi pământul nostru îşi va da rodul său;
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ ὁ Κύριος δώσει χρηστότητα, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν δώσει τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set his steps in the way.

translations.ron: Dreptatea înaintea Lui va merge şi va pune pe cale paşii Săi.
